part_number.note: 23-digit Model Option Table for the original SEL-487E. Calibrated against genuine part numbers read from the SEL-487E Instruction Manual CID/CONFIGURATION-INFO blocks (0487E0X41111XXB4H74444X, 0487E0X41111XXB4H74424X, 0487E0141112C2B4H70X44X). No relay Model Option Table ordering sheet for the base SEL-487E exists in the local corpus: WI-10630 is a wiring-harness sheet (Part Number WA0487EA..., rejected), and WI-15513 covers the newer 25-digit SEL-487E-5. High-confidence positions (8 power supply, 17 mounting, 19/21/22 I/O board slots) are confirmed by the instruction manual and/or the master drawing layers and decode the real part numbers; the analog-input/CT-VT block (positions 9-16) and the protection/configuration digits (6, 7, 20) are not documented in any available ordering sheet and are marked low confidence with the observed genuine values. NOTE: the drawing layers in this file's model_to_layers actually model the 400-series variants (SEL-487E-3/-4 at pos 6 = 3/4, and SEL-487E-5, 25-digit); their front-block positions differ from the original SEL-487E encoded here.
